title: FrostHex
description: FrostHex is the BIGGEST ice boat racing server in existence! Join us at FrostHex.com
body:
This is FrostHex; Minecraft's biggest Boatracing server in existence. 
As of writing this we have over 880 tracks to choose from with more than 108 *thousand* players having finished at least a single lap on one of our tracks!

Will we see you on the ice? Join us today!

_Download the recommended modpack here:_ [Ice Boat Racing modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ice-boat-racing)
